title: Long types
summary: A type too long for one line is written in lines of at most 60 columns
prose: A part that does not fit is named by a Greek letter and spelled on its own line below, two columns further in; a part written twice shares its letter. A list of arguments or parameters that still does not fit wraps, its lines aligned after the bracket opening it.
